svg.title: Valdara Industries, Serra 180 – Parcels (knocked down, 3 per bench) (VI-DWG-B180-006)
svg.text: bolt set in a bag, taped to the tray
PARCEL 2 OF 3: frame carton with bolt set
Carton: FEFCO 0320 tray and lid, single-wall C flute 560 g/m²; corrugated corner pads; inside
782 x 660 x 90 for a frame of 742 x 620 x 70 (clearance 20/20/10 mm). Carton mass 1.12 kg.
Bundle: five slats 3 + 2, corrugated edge protectors 5 mm, end caps, 4 PET straps, film; packing 0.59 kg.
Marks on every parcel: "Serra 180 VI-B180 parcel n of 3", the lot number and the GTIN; on the bundle "two-person lift".
Handling (ISO 11228-1): one person up to 25 kg, two people up to about 33 kg; parcels 14.5 / 15.3 / 18.5 kg; bench gross 48.3 kg.
Slats of thermally modified ash (from May 2026). With oak slats (until April): bundle 22.9 kg, bench gross 52.7 kg.
corrugated board, PET straps, PE film mass 48.3 kg gross per bench
